9934477.name: Classic Fried Chicken / 炸鸡
9934477.description: Classic fried chicken, often known as Southern-style, features broiler chicken pieces coated in seasoned flour or batter, deep-fried or pan-fried to a deep golden-brown.

9934478.name: Classic Fried Chicken wings / 炸鸡翼
9934478.description: Two pieces of classic fried chicken wings are a popular, quick appetizer or snack featuring chicken wing sections (typically one drumette and one flat) that are battered or breaded and deep-fried until golden brown.

9934479.name: Taifeng Fried Chicken (避風塘雞)
9934479.description: Taifeng fried chicken is characterized as a "from-scratch" dish featuring a buttermilk-marinated, golden, and crispy exterior with juicy meat.

9934480.name: Taifeng Fried chicken wings (避风塘鸡翼)
9934480.description: Taifeng chicken wings are a famous Hong Kong-style dish characterized by deep-fried chicken wings tossed in a fragrant, crunchy mixture of fermented black beans, abundant garlic, dried chilies, and panko breadcrumbs. This dish is inspired by traditional fisherman cuisine, delivering a savory, spicy, and deeply aromatic flavor profile

9934481.name: Flamy Fried chicken / 香辣炸鸡
9934481.description: Flamy Fried Chicken is a intensely spicy, crunchy, and vibrant red-orange fried chicken characterized by a bold coating of cayenne pepper, chili powder, and paprika. It features a deeply crispy exterior, often achieved through seasoned flour mixed with cornstarch or crushed hot chips, covering a moist, spicy-marinated interior.

9934482.name: Flamy fried chicken Wings / 炸雞翅
9934482.description: Flamy fried chicken wings are characterized by a fiery, blistering crunch, usually featuring a thin, shatter-crisp skin seasoned with intense spices. Often double-fried for maximum crunch, these wings are juicy on the inside, typically seasoned with cayenne pepper, paprika, and garlic to deliver a lingering "flame" or "hot" kick, say the insights from.

9934483.name: Xiangla Fried Chicken / 辣子鸡
9934483.description: Xiangla fried chicken, commonly known as is a signature Sichuan dish characterized by crispy, bite-sized chicken pieces buried under a "mountain" of dried red chilies, Sichuan peppercorns, and aromatics. It is a mala (numbing and spicy) dish that aroma and flavor rather than heavy, thick batter.

9934484.name: Xiangla Fried chicken wings / 香辣炸鸡翅
9934484.description: Xiangla fried chicken wings (香辣鸡翅) are a vibrant Sichuan-style dish known for being crispy, hot, and numbing. They are typically deep-fried until crunchy and then stir-fried or tossed with a mix of dried chili peppers, Sichuan peppercorns, and aromatics like garlic and ginger, creating a "dry-fried" texture that is intensely flavorful.

9934485.name: Classic Chicken strips / 鸡柳
9934485.description: Chicken strips are slices of chicken meat, typically from the breast or tenderloin, that are breaded and deep-fried or baked until golden brown. Often served as a popular appetiser or main course with dipping sauces, they are similar to chicken tenders but generally represent wider, hand-cut pieces rather than the specific, smaller pectoral muscle known as the tenderloin.

9934486.name: Flamy Chicken Strips / 辣子鸡
9934486.description: Flamy (or "Flaming Hot") chicken strips are breaded, tender white-meat chicken breast fillets, coated in a spicy, crunchy chilli seasoning, often including paprika and red pepper. They feature a fiery, vibrant red exterior with a crispy texture and a juicy, seasoned interior.

9934487.name: Taifeng Chicken Strips / 炸雞排
9934487.description: Taifeng Chicken Strips (often referred to as Crispy Chicken Cutlet or Fried Chicken Cutlet) are a popular, world-renowned menu item featuring tender, boneless chicken strips that are coated in a light, crunchy batter and deep-fried to a golden brown.

9934488.name: Suan Fried Chicken Full Leg / 蒜香炸雞脾
9934488.description: A Chinese Suan Fried chicken full leg features a bone-in, skin-on chicken leg quarter that is first braised in a savory, aromatic soy sauce broth and then flash-fried. The result is a tender, deeply flavorful dark meat with an incredibly crispy, shiny, and golden-brown exterior.

9934489.name: Suan Fried Chicken Wings / 蒜香炸鸡翅
9934489.description: Suan fried chicken wings are celebrated for their shattering crispiness, light craggy skin, and savory, umami-rich flavor. They are typically marinated in a blend of soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, and Asian aromatics, then double-fried to achieve a juicy interior and highly distinct, addictive crunch.

নরম চিকেনকে ধীরে ধীরে গ্রিল করা হয়—

10019472.name: Arabian Delight
10019472.description: A professional, high-resolution photograph of two branded 'Craves' premium date and nut milkshakes, set on a rustic wooden table in a softly blurred, warm cafe environment. The smaller milkshake (250ml) is on the left in a clear plastic cup with a domed lid and striped paper straw, topped with crushed pistachios and saffron. The larger milkshake (350ml) is on the right in a clear cup with a flat lid and matching straw. Both cups clearly display the magenta 'Craves' logo and volume measurements. Between the drinks is a small bowl of mixed nuts (almonds, pistachios, walnuts) and two whole dates, arranged on a branded napkin. The background shows a busy, out-of-focus cafe with pendant lights and patrons.

10019788.name: Lacchi

On the right, a larger 350ml clear plastic cup with a flat lid and a matching straw holds a more generous portion. Both cups feature the 'Craves' logo, volume markings, and light condensation. 10019655.name: Lemonade

10019703.name: Papaya
10019703.description: A professional, high-resolution food photography shot on a rustic wooden table, featuring two distinct sizes of 'Craves' branded papaya juice. On the left, a 250ml clear plastic cup with a domed lid and a striped paper straw holds vibrant orange, pulpy papaya juice. On the right, a larger 350ml clear plastic cup with a flat lid and a matching straw holds a more generous portion. Both cups prominently display the 'Craves' logo. Between the cups, a branded 'Craves' napkin rests, garnished with fresh papaya cubes and a sprig of mint. The background shows a softly blurred, warm, modern cafe interior with pendant lights and greenery. The lighting is natural and inviting, highlighting the texture of the juice and condensation.

10019708.name: Pineapple
10019708.description: A professional, high-resolution food photography shot on a rustic wooden table in a softly blurred, warm cafe environment. On the right, a distinctly larger 350ml cup with a flat lid and a matching straw holds a more generous portion of the same juice. Both cups prominently display the brown 'Craves' logo and volume markings. Between the two drinks, a small cluster of fresh pineapple wedges and a sprig of mint rests on a branded 'Craves' napkin. 10019714.name: Malta

10019781.name: Spicy Tamarind
